title: Shabbetai the Fruit-Hoarder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Yoma 82b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.82b.2-3) relates that a pregnant woman smelled food. The case came before R' Chanina, who said to whisper to her. They whispered, but she was not calmed. He applied to the unborn child the verse “The wicked are estranged from the womb.” She gave birth to Shabbetai, the fruit-hoarder.
In [Bava Batra 90b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.90b.5), Rabbi Yochanan gives Shabbetai the fruit-hoarder as an example.[^1]

notes.text: The first pregnancy story expressly gives the words whispered about Yom Kippur. Rabbi Chanina’s separate case starts on 82b and concludes with Shabbetai’s birth at [Yoma 83a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.83a.1). The supplied Hebrew repeats the word “her” at a line break and repeats the Bava Batra locator and reporting formula.
